---
title: Red Onion Monferrina
id: MAR-0024
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 6
time_min: 45
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g crescenza or stracchino
- 0.5 red bell pepper
- 0.5 red chili pepper
- 1 red spring onion
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice
- 1 teaspoon sweet paprika
- 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Peel the red bell pepper, cut it into small pieces and put it in the blender.
2. Add the crumbled red chili pepper, sliced red spring onion, oil, paprika, lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
3. Blend the ingredients and add the mixture to the crescenza.
4. Mix to obtain a homogeneous cream, which you will keep in the refrigerator until serving.
